description.en: The region in which the instance resides.

description.zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the VPC in which the endpoint resides.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于获取用户账号下可用于实例专有网络（VPC）列表，以便在创建或管理数据库实例时选择合适的网络环境。
descriptions.en: Queries the list of available virtual private clouds (VPCs) under your account for an instance, so that you can select an appropriate network environment when creating or managing a database instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx describe-rds-vswitches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-a --vpc-id vpc-bp1ndou0000twoedlmru0 --region cn-hangzhou
